continent_note: UN M49 Western Asia. Frequently placed in Europe by other schemes.

editorial_note: Rendered on the map for geographic completeness but carries no population, economy, or people data. Its continent page states plainly that it has no permanent inhabitants and shows only land area and biome data. Excluded from all per-capita and density rankings so it cannot distort them.

name_official: Territory of the French Southern and Antarctic Lands
continent_note: French Southern and Antarctic Lands. Uninhabited apart from research staff. Kept in Antarctica because it includes the Adelie Land claim, though its island groups sit in the southern Indian Ocean.
UN M49 Western Asia. Frequently placed in Europe by other schemes.

name_official: Nation of Brunei, Abode of Peace

continent_note: Bouvet Island (Norway). Uninhabited sub-Antarctic island in the South Atlantic. Assigned to Antarctica rather than Africa or South America, neither of which is a good fit.

DEPARTS from UN M49, which places Cyprus in Western Asia. Assigned to Europe because it is an EU member state and is conventionally treated as European. This is the clearest case where we override M49.
Transcontinental (Sinai is in Asia). Assigned to Africa, where the overwhelming majority of land and population sits.

editorial_note: Listed by the UN as a non-self-governing territory; sovereignty unresolved between Morocco and the Sahrawi Arab Democratic Republic. UN WPP publishes a separate population series. Most World Bank indicators are absent. Rendered as its own polygon with a distinct hatch, not merged into Morocco.

name_official: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

continent_note: UN M49 Western Asia. Frequently placed in Europe by other schemes.
Autonomous territory of Denmark; geographically North American. Appears on the North America page, not Europe.

name_official: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China
editorial_note: Not a sovereign state, but both UN WPP and the World Bank publish full separate series, and its demographics differ sharply from mainland China. Gets a country page; its population is NOT double-counted into the China total or the Asia total.

continent_note: Heard Island and McDonald Islands (Australia). Uninhabited sub-Antarctic. Assigned to Antarctica rather than Oceania.
Transcontinental (Papua provinces are in Oceania). Assigned to Asia.
Transcontinental. Assigned to Asia per UN M49 (Central Asia).

Federation of Saint Christopher and Nevis

editorial_note: Same treatment as Hong Kong. Too small to be visible at 110m map resolution; appears in tables and via search, with a minimum-size marker on the map.

continent_note: Assigned to North America, the conventional placement. UN M49 places it in 'Latin America and the Caribbean' within the Americas.

name_official: Republic of the Union of Myanmar
Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands

continent_note: Isthmus state. Assigned to North America; the Darien Gap is the conventional NA/SA divide.

name_official: Independent State of Papua New Guinea
continent_note: Assigned to Oceania (M49 Melanesia).

editorial_note: UN General Assembly granted non-member observer State status in 2012. UN WPP publishes as 'State of Palestine'. Natural Earth splits West Bank and Gaza into separate polygons; we dissolve them into one PSE entity so the geometry matches the single data row, and note the discontiguity.

continent_note: Transcontinental. Assigned to Europe: roughly three-quarters of the population lives west of the Urals, and conventional atlases place it in Europe. Its Asian landmass means Europe's land-area figure is inflated relative to a strict geographic split -- flagged on the Europe continent page.

name_official: South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands
continent_note: South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands. Uninhabited apart from research staff. Commonly grouped with South America; assigned to Antarctica here for consistency with the other uninhabited sub-Antarctic territories. This is the weakest of the four assignments and is worth revisiting.

name_common: Saint Helena, Ascension and Tristan da Cunha
name_official: Saint Helena, Ascension and Tristan da Cunha
Most Serene Republic of San Marino
Democratic Republic of São Tomé and Príncipe

continent_note: Assigned to Asia (M49 South-Eastern Asia), though sometimes grouped with Oceania.
Caribbean. In the 7-continent model the Caribbean falls under North America despite sitting on the South American shelf.
Transcontinental. Assigned to Asia, matching UN M49 (Western Asia); about 95% of its land area is in Anatolia. Reasonable people place it in Europe; documented here so the choice is visible.

editorial_note: ISO 3166-1 assigns TWN. Not a UN member. UN WPP publishes it as 'China, Taiwan Province of China' -- we use that series but label the entity 'Taiwan', which is the common English name and the one readers will search for. World Bank does not publish most indicators for Taiwan, so many Economy/Education fields will legitimately render 'not available from World Bank'.

continent_note: US Minor Outlying Islands are scattered across the Pacific and Caribbean. Assigned to Oceania as the least-wrong single bucket; noted as an approximation.

name_official: Virgin Islands of the United States
Territory of the Wallis and Futuna Islands

editorial_note: Has no ISO 3166-1 code. XKX is a user-assigned code adopted by the World Bank and IMF; REST Countries uses XKX, UN M49 has no entry. Recognised by roughly half of UN member states. UN WPP publishes Kosovo within Serbia for some series -- where that happens we report the Serbia figure as covering Kosovo and say so, rather than subtracting an estimate.
